caption: The drawing depicts a blue and white teacup and saucer set, shown in two configurations on a plain beige background. At the top, a single teacup is illustrated in a side view, with a handle on the right and subtle orange and blue shadows giving it form. The rim of the cup and a thin line around its base are highlighted in blue, and faint blue text or design appears on the left side. Below, the same teacup is depicted sitting on a matching saucer. The cup in this configuration displays a coat of arms with a red and white shield and a plume above it, flanked by blue script letters. The saucer mirrors the cup's color scheme and features blue edging around its rim with a scalloped design. The composition is centered on the page, and the artist’s signature, “Harold Ramsay,” is in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Teacup and Saucer
